Chen was chased by many people with knives, injured and fled to the hospital. The Kinmen prosecuting police quickly investigated the case. Five involved juveniles were ruled admitted. The 33-year-old Huang surnamed Lord was suspected of being detained and barred from seeing. The knife-chasing image was exposed like a police officer in the movie "Ancient Confusion". In the picture, a number of cars suddenly arrived at the negotiating site, and a number of men got off the car with a knife and chased the man surnamed Chen. The surrounding crowd also swarmed up. The man surnamed Chen fled all the way from the Dongmen Cuisine Market to the direction of Dai Tianfu. In the process, he was still chased by someone with a knife. Chen Nao finally fled to the alley near Dai Tianfu to hide. Due to his serious injury, he fell on the roadside stone chair. After being sent to Kinmen Hospital for treatment, he was sent to Taiwan for surgery.
